observations: The field view retains its overhead spans and steel side columns. The actual imported commando/interaction and existing rachni are visible.

In the native three-rachni combat, the previous overhead-beam correction already exposes Ashley completely. The camera-facing vertical column still masks part of the central rachni; this is the baseline finding targeted by the new change.
No new body pose, primary-reference likeness, full campaign progression or fresh build is established by these screenshots.
